subject.title: fix(workboard): report active claims before dependency errors

question: Which of the three equivalent fixes for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/104050 should be the canonical landing PR?
rationale: All three PRs are mergeable and implement the same correct store-level change; this PR now has sufficient production-tool proof, while no maintainer review or sponsorship establishes a canonical candidate automatically.

options.title: Land this PR
options.body: Use this smallest proof-positive candidate, refresh it onto current main, run exact-head checks, and close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104067 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104071 as duplicates after merge.

options.title: Choose a sibling
options.body: Land one of the other proof-positive candidates and close this PR plus the remaining sibling with a link to the selected canonical merge.

recommendation.title: Land this PR
recommendation.body: Use this smallest proof-positive candidate, refresh it onto current main, run exact-head checks, and close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104067 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104071 as duplicates after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame provides the strongest available recent history connection to the workboard store and tool paths involved in the choice.
